meta.description: Official website of the Astoria National Domain Registry Authority (ANRD), responsible for the administration, governance and stability of the national top-level domain .aor.

lAnrd.title: The Astoria National Domain Registry Authority
lAnrd.text: The ANRD is the national authority responsible for the administration, governance and stability of the national top-level domain .aor.

leAor.title: The national .aor domain
leAor.text: The national top-level domain .aor is the namespace of the Republic of Astoria. The ANRD ensures its governance and operation.

nomsDeDomaine.title: .aor domain names
nomsDeDomaine.text: Register, manage, transfer and follow the life cycle of your .aor domain names with accredited registrars.

registre.title: The national .aor registry
registre.text: The ANRD operates the national registry: the sovereign infrastructure that administers the .aor zone, its DNS, its security and its data.

bureauxEnregistrement.title: Registrars
bureauxEnregistrement.text: The registrars accredited by the ANRD form the ecosystem through which holders obtain and manage their .aor domain names.

reglesPolitiques.title: Rules & policies
reglesPolitiques.text: The regulatory and institutional framework of the national domain: registration policies, pricing, disputes and applicable texts.

ressources.title: Resources
ressources.text: Guides, data, publications and support for holders, registrars and developers of the .aor domain.

footer.contentDescription: The official portal of the Astoria National Domain Registry Authority (ANRD), the authority of the national top-level domain .aor.

home.metaTitle: ANRD — Astoria National Domain Registry Authority

hero.kicker: Republic of Astoria — National Domain Registry Authority
hero.title: The Astoria National Domain Registry Authority
hero.lead: The ANRD administers the national .aor domain, ensures the stability of its registry and establishes the rules that govern its use.

aor.title: The national domain of Astoria
aor.lead: .aor is the Republic of Astoria's national top-level domain: the namespace on which institutions, organisations and citizens express their presence in the Astorian digital space.

what.title: What is .aor?
what.text: The national extension that identifies the actors of the Astorian digital space.

role.title: Its role
role.text: A mark of belonging to the national domain, for institutions and organisations alike.

operation.title: How it works
operation.text: The ANRD administers the .aor zone; registrars distribute it.

importance.title: Its importance
importance.text: A stable and sovereign national identification infrastructure.

stats.label: The .aor at a glance
stats.note: These indicators will be published as soon as the registry data is available.

registry.title: A sovereign infrastructure serving the .aor
registry.lead: The ANRD is the authority that operates and governs the national registry. Registrars are the interface between holders and the registry.
registry.intro: From the holder to the name system, every actor of the namespace is linked to the national registry:
registry.caption: The ANRD governs the namespace; registrars support the holders.

lookup.title: Search a domain name
lookup.lead: Check whether a name is available in the .aor domain. The search will be connected to the national registry once it goes live.

result.states: Once live, the registry will return one of these states:

steps.title: Register a .aor
steps.lead: The ANRD administers the registry; it does not sell domains. Registration always happens through an accredited registrar.

choose.title: Choose
choose.text: Find a name that suits your activity or your organisation.

check.title: Check
check.text: Check the availability of the name in the .aor domain.

manage.text: Renew and administer your domain with ease.

registrars.title: The ANRD administers the registry. Registrars support the holders.
registrars.lead: Accredited registrars form the ecosystem through which holders obtain and manage their .aor domain names.

governance.title: A national domain governed by transparent rules
governance.lead: The use of the .aor is governed by public policies, versioned and binding, adopted by the ANRD.

infrastructure.title: A critical and resilient national infrastructure
infrastructure.lead: The .aor registry relies on a robust, signed and monitored DNS infrastructure. The service status is published continuously on the government status platform.

resilience.title: Resilience
resilience.text: The continuity and availability of the national service.

transparency.title: A registry open about its data
transparency.lead: The ANRD publishes the information and data that describe the evolution of the national namespace.

institution.title: Administer today. Prepare the namespace of tomorrow.
institution.lead: The Astoria National Domain Registry Authority watches over the national domain: it administers it, guarantees its operation and prepares its future.
